crossRefs.note: Moza became the father of Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

people.name: Azel
people.line: Descendant of Saul, had six sons

people.name: Binea
people.line: Descendant of King Saul and Jonathan

people.name: Eleasah
people.line: Descendant of Saul and Jonathan, son of Rapha

people.name: Moza
people.line: Son of Zimri, descendant of King Saul

people.name: Raphah
people.line: Son of Binea, a descendant of King Saul

translations.web: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
translations.bsb: Moza was the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
translations.kjv: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
translations.asv: And Moza begat Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
